scope: Isolated local PostgreSQL; real API ingestion for correctness and incremental updates, synthetic published index fixture for load. No production capacity claim.
checks: Historical fill, shared definitions independent of period, cross-day and repeated attempts exactly match direct engine
Only affected actors are rebuilt; failed publication rolls back atomically and retries without double counting
Concurrent ingestion during preprocessing remains queued and converges to the exact result
Corrections and anonymous linking rebuild exact sequences; account identity stays at event time
Definition revisions, proactive saved-period warming and permission checks on cached participants
Three-attempt failure limit, explicit retry, operational disable/enable rebuild and retained-history cleanup
